propositions: A cancelled or timed-out mutation job casts Verified -1 with message 'CANCELLED: <url>' that names neither the job nor its failure reason, requiring manual triage by reading the run logs.

The gerrit-review-action hardcodes its message template as '${STATUS}: ${SERVER_URL}/${REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}' with no input for custom text, so vote message detail cannot be enriched in place.

The solution posts job-level triage detail (job name, outcome: TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED, duration, html_url) as a comment-only Gerrit review after the vote is cast, guarded on vote-type != success.

The summarize step fetches this run's jobs from GitHub actions API and per-job annotations, using annotations to distinguish a timeout from a simple cancellation, and strips dangerous characters before passing the summary to a remote ssh gerrit review command.
